Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Nueva Ecija, Batangas, Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Calauan, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan), Cavite(Maragondon, Naic, Ternate, Tagaytay, Alfonso, Magallanes, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Tanza, Mendez, Indang, Trece Martires), Tarlac(Camiling, Santa Ignacia, Tarlac City, La Paz, Victoria, Gerona, San Manuel, Ramos, Paniqui, Pura, Anao, Moncada, Concepcion), Rizal(Binangonan, Cardona, Pililla, Jala-Jala, Tanay, Baras, Morong) and Bulacan(San Miguel, Dona Remedios Trinidad).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Metro Manila, Bataan, Zambales, Pampanga, Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Silang, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario), Laguna(Cabuyao, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro), Rizal(Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Angono, Cainta, Taytay, Teresa), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, Mayantoc, San Clemente, San Jose) and Bulacan(Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Norzagaray, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Rafael, Santa Maria) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
